user_story:
As a user, I want to navigate through a multi-level navigation menu on the demoqa website so that I can access various functionalities easily. 
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Clicking on 'Main Item 1' should not change the URL and keep the user on the menu page.
2. Clicking on 'Sub Sub Item 1' should change the URL to '/menu' and display the corresponding content.
